subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text:
stimulus: the man said to me where are you going i am going to Varsity said i did you go to Varsity yesterday no i replied why did you not go i was very busy said i. Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: The man said to me, "Where are you going?" "I am going to Varsity," said I. "Did you go to Varsity yesterday?" "No," I replied. "Why did you not go?" "I was very busy," said I.  For Question No. 12, 13, 14 & 15, See Solution to Suggestions; Composition Part ইংরেজি দ্বিতীয় পত্র  115
